brief:
Galatasaray's chairman said Israel's government filed a complaint with UEFA after the Turkish football club's supporters displayed pro-Palestine banners, Al Jazeera English reported. The club leadership did not specify which matches featured the banners or what the Israeli complaint contained.

The incident reflects mounting tensions around pro-Palestinian expression in European sports, where governing bodies have faced pressure from multiple directions over how to handle political displays at matches.
dek: Galatasaray’s chairman says Israel’s Netanyahu government has reported the club to UEFA over pro-Palestine fan banners.
title: Israel complains to UEFA over Galatasaray's Palestine banners
